derivation: Derived GEOMETRICALLY from the real TY2025 f1040s2.pdf (IRS fillable form): for every entry, the widget /Rect of the field (read with pypdf) was matched against the printed line labels extracted with `pdftotext -bbox` on the blank form; a field is assigned to the line whose printed label sits on the same row (widget y-center within ~6pt of the label row) and, for table columns, whose x-band matches the printed column. Checkbox on-states were read from each widget's /AP /N appearance keys with pypdf. This form's AcroForm root is form1[0], not topmostSubform[0]. Line 4's amount field is f1_15 (widget row y-center 318, x-band 504-576, matches the printed '4 Self-employment tax. Attach Schedule SE' row); the neighboring Line4_ReadOrder text field f1_14 and the exemption checkboxes c1_3/c1_4/c1_5 (Forms 4361/4029) are NOT mapped. The total is printed line 21 on page 2 ('Add lines 17e and 17z... enter here and on Form 1040, line 23'-family total row) = f2_24.

entries.note: Name header field (page 1); filled from the stored identity when present.
SSN header field (page 1); digits-only; report value masked.
Line 4 'Self-employment tax. Attach Schedule SE' amount field (page 1).
Line 21 total other taxes (page 2), flows to Form 1040 line 23; widget row matches the printed '21' label row.
